rules.author: 0xbd733bc56ec4a55fa25c068b9306b0171335d199
rules.text: Allow external publication of diagnostic logs.

rules.author: 0x2818b7bc95a05df416e7c2e7f928e12fe4715cfd
rules.text: Prohibit external publication of diagnostic logs. This restriction overrides R0, the general permission to publish diagnostic logs.

rules.author: 0xc73a3ded1164883c41ab87ed13a279b2b4cfd4b8
rules.text: As an exception to R1, allow external diagnostic bundles consisting entirely of synthetic benchmark logs. This exception does not cover logs containing customer information.

rules.author: 0xbd733bc56ec4a55fa25c068b9306b0171335d199
rules.text: Allow external publication of synthetic diagnostic logs. For exactly this action, this rule overrides the prohibition in R1.

rules.author: 0x2818b7bc95a05df416e7c2e7f928e12fe4715cfd
rules.text: Prohibit external publication of all diagnostic logs, including synthetic diagnostic logs. For exactly this action, this rule overrides the permission in R0.

rules.author: 0xc73a3ded1164883c41ab87ed13a279b2b4cfd4b8
rules.text: Allow viewing diagnostic logs only on an internal dashboard; external publication is outside this permission.

requests.reason: R0 and R1 are NOT_APPLICABLE because the action is internal viewing, not external publication. R2 is UNCLEAR because it is unknown if the dashboard entry contains diagnostic logs.
